name: Wingbuddy Telegram Assistant
description: A Telegram personal AI assistant backed by Google Gemini with a Strict Zero-Fallback Policy. Features include persistent context, switchable AI personas, VIP user tiers, smart quotas, real-time web search grounding, multi-step reasoning, multimodal image and video generation, semantic vector memory recall, memory extraction from ChatGPT/Claude, and bulk chat history migration from external AI platforms.
